titles.en: The Sea and the Land of Busy Bees

continuity.opening: After swimming through the storm, Pinocchio reaches an island with no sign of Geppetto.
continuity.closing: A false rumour brings Pinocchio away from school and into a confrontation on the beach.
continuity.next: The beach quarrel turns dangerous, forcing Pinocchio to choose between escape and responsibility.

learningObjective: Connect honest work, repeated habits, and temptation while explaining how daily choices build character.

beats.title: The Shore and the Dolphin
beats.purpose: Carry Pinocchio from exhausted survival to frightening news of the Shark.

beats.title: A Town That Works
beats.purpose: Contrast Pinocchio’s hunger with a community built on contribution.

beats.title: The First Honest Meal
beats.purpose: Make humble physical work produce a concrete and satisfying reward.

beats.title: The Fairy Grown
beats.purpose: Reunite Pinocchio with the Fairy while showing that time and choices have consequences.

beats.title: A Promise to Learn
beats.purpose: Define becoming human as a pattern of responsible actions rather than magic.

beats.title: Better Habits
beats.purpose: Show gradual growth through study, restraint, and repeated effort.

beats.title: The Rumour of the Shark
beats.purpose: Use concern for Geppetto as the emotional opening for temptation.

beats.title: Away from the Lesson
beats.purpose: Let a seemingly brief exception carry Pinocchio beyond his intended boundary.
